label.description: Display name of the font (e.g. 'Roboto', 'Open Sans')

font_stack.description: CSS font-family value stored on typography styles and branding settings (e.g. 'Roboto, sans-serif')

google_family.description: Google Fonts API family token used to build the stylesheet URL (e.g. 'Open+Sans'); empty for system fonts that need no web load

source.description: Where the font comes from: a Google web font or a system/local font

is_base.description: Always-on base font (Poppins, Degular Medium) that is loaded everywhere and cannot be removed

is_active.description: Whether the font is available for selection and loaded on public pages
